Option A (Pilot-friendly, lower up-front cash):
- 3-month pilot, reduced SLA 99.9% (operational fallback policy enabled).
- Compliance add-on discount: 40% off standard add-on rate for pilot period.
- Implementation fee: invoiced up front but amortizable over 12 monthly invoices on request (we’ll include amortization on the invoice schedule).

Option B (Balanced, standard SLA):
- 12-month initial commitment, SLA 99.99%.
- Compliance add-on at standard enterprise rate, implementation fee partially credited (50% credit applied against first quarter invoice).
- HSM seat can be structured as a monthly seat fee instead of pass-through (reduces monthly variability).

Option C (CAPEX-friendly):
- One-time higher implementation + HSM seat fee, larger discount on recurring add-ons. We can accept amortization in your bookkeeping but Redwood invoices one up-front charge unless Legal requests a split-invoice schedule.

Other notes:
- Evidence delivery: audit log exports and SOC artefacts can be staged; we commit to an evidence delivery SLA (T+7 business days) for pilot and T+3 for committed customers.
- We can offer a one-time migration assistance credit ($15k) if you sign a 12-month commitment following the pilot.
